text: そ　そんなの　おしえる　わけ　ねえだろ！

structure.jp: おしえる　わけ　ねえだろ！

patterns.name: 〜わけがない
patterns.span: おしえる　わけ　ねえ
patterns.explanation: わけがない after a verb means 'there's no way that would happen'. ねえ is the rough slurred form of ない, and が is dropped. おしえる　わけ　ねえ = 'no way we'd tell'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろ is a rough short form of だろう, pushing the listener to agree. ねえだろ = 'there isn't, obviously!'
